Use case: precise-object-edit, complete rear-view painted character skin.
Input image 1 is the approved BACK-RIGHT / NORTHEAST nine-pose sheet, the strict POSE, CAMERA, LAYOUT and SCALE reference. Input image 2 is this character's newly generated FRONT walk sheet, defining the SAME identity, clothing, props and rendering. Image 3 is the selected single-view wardrobe reference.
Repaint all nine figures in image 1 as this character seen from BEHIND, all facing away and right, showing the back of the head/clothes. No front-facing eyes or faces. Exactly preserve the nine corresponding boot positions, supporting legs, sole angles, arm swing, body scale and direction of image 1. Frames 1–8 are the eight different walk phases; frame 9 bottom-right is neutral standing. This is an appearance repaint on the approved motion family, not new poses.
1254x1254 square transparent RGBA canvas, EXACT 3x3 equal 418x418 cells. Preserve full-body height and head/boot scale from the approved pose template, warm painterly shading and crisp warm dark-brown outlines. Every hat, accessory and carried prop stays inside its own cell. The outfit reads identically from behind: apron straps/ties, satchel strap or cap as appropriate; no belt buckle, front apron pocket, front face or chest gauge painted on the back. Keep props visibly attached and consistent across frames. No shadows, no floor/background, labels, grid lines, extra poses or cropped figures.
CHARACTER IDENTITY:
Nell, the older automaton-maker and landlady: warm medium-brown skin, kind older face, silver-blue hair braided into a bun, round brass spectacles with a fine chain. Teal-green cardigan over a cream collared blouse, canvas BIB work apron with only a small brass screwdriver and open-ended spanner in its pocket, plum work skirt, plum-brown sturdy boots. Match the supplied selected concept. Her short wooden walking stick can be carried in the same near hand in each painted phase, staying inside the cell and with its ferrule no lower than the planted boot. Keep the opposite arm's walk swing and both boot gestures readable.
